name: UNIV 3696
title: Mentored Research Experience
description: Mentored research at UConn or UConn Health of 45 hours for every enrolled credit. Evaluation by the research mentor aligned with individualized goals. May be repeated for a total of 16 credits.
requirement_description: Application with the Office of Undergraduate Research required. Research Learning Agreement must be completed prior to the end of the second week of the enrollment term.
